citation.source_text: Mac revenue was $8 billion, up 15% year over year, driven by continued strength across the portfolio, including MacBook Air, Mac Mini, and MacBook Pro.

claims.claim: Mac revenue was $8 billion, up 15% year over year, driven by continued strength across the portfolio, including MacBook Air, Mac Mini, and MacBook Pro.

citation.source_text: Our revenue of $94 billion was up 10% year over year and is a new June quarter record.

claims.claim: Apple reported June-quarter revenue of $94 billion, up 10% year over year and a June-quarter record.

citation.source_text: iPad revenue was $6.6 billion, down 8% year over year, which was expected given the difficult compare against the launch of the iPad Air and iPad Pro in the year ago quarter.

claims.claim: iPad revenue was $6.6 billion, down 8% year over year, which was expected given the difficult compare against the launch of the iPad Air and iPad Pro in the year ago quarter.

citation.source_text: Wearables home and accessories revenue was $7.4 billion, down 9% year over year.

claims.claim: Wearables, Home and Accessories revenue was $7.4 billion, down 9% year over year.

citation.source_text: This strong business performance led to June quarter records for both net income at $23.4 billion and diluted earnings per share of $1.57, which was up 12% year over year.

claims.claim: Apple reported June-quarter records for net income of $23.4 billion and diluted earnings per share of $1.57; diluted EPS was up 12% year over year.

overall_summary: Apple reported June-quarter revenue of $94 billion, up 10% year over year, and Mac revenue of $8 billion, up 15%. Net income was a June-quarter record of $23.4 billion; diluted EPS was also a June-quarter record at $1.57, up 12% year over year. iPad revenue fell 8% and Wearables, Home and Accessories revenue fell 9% year over year.
